name: Matrix Games (Engle Matrix Game Method)
description: Argument-based adjudication wargaming methodology developed by Chris Engle, explicitly designed for situations too complex for traditional rule-based models. Players make structured arguments for desired outcomes; a facilitator or umpire adjudicates based on argument quality and plausibility. Published and disseminated by John Curry and Peter Perla. Maps directly to Cynefin's probe-sense-respond logic for complex and chaotic environments.
reputation: influential methodology adopted by UK Defence Academy, Swedish Defence University, and numerous war colleges; published reference is Curry & Price 'Matrix Games for Modern Wargaming'
notes: Rules are minimal and freely adaptable. The method is specifically suited to hybrid warfare, grey-zone conflict, and political-military interactions where rigid rule systems fail. Core reference: Curry & Price, 'Matrix Games for Modern Wargaming' (2017).
